Round-0 median 75.5, minimum 70, two cases passing at 88 (n30, n31), no P1 and 9 P2; on the F and K items the median reached 80 for the first time. 42 of 73 lost points were `skill`, 25 `primitive` and 6 `rubric`. Its fix rows (v3-expr-8-kit-fixes, v3-expr-8-contract, v3-expr-8-skill, v3-expr-8-rubric) change the heatmap keyboard ring, BarList error titles and scroll cue, the loading height at 390 and list-row dimming in the kit; a Sparkline point readout, bar value labels with a clamped stack, and nested table rows behind a Spec; the skill's fact count, one view, answer on the mark, part-to-whole and heatmap lines; and three rubric sentences reviewers read two ways. This cycle measures again on six cases that have never run. docs/v3/EXPRESSION.md is the protocol; it specialises docs/v3/CYCLES.md.

change: Follow docs/v3/EXPRESSION.md § The loop for cases n33, n34, n35, n36, n37 and n38 (all native; none has run; n39 stays for cycle 10). Before pinning, check TuffUI (github.com/yurigdesigner/tuffui) for visualization components published after `f31ea2b` (2026-11-16; cycles 7 and 8 found none); for each one, add a `c` case, its reference row and shot (`.evidence/v3-shots/expression-6/ref-shot.ts` in the main checkout shoots a page at 1440x1000 with reduced motion), and run it in place of a native case. With fewer than four referenced cases the cycle file reports the convergence clause on the referenced cases it has and says the clause cannot be met in full; with none, the verdict counts are empty. You are the lead: you spawn, shoot, collect and diagnose; you build nothing and score nothing. (1) Builders: one fresh subagent per case on the default worker tier, with the case row verbatim, the scenario id `expr-<case id>`, and the fence of cycle 8 (its builder prompt, `.evidence/v3-shots/expression-8/builder-prompt.md` in the main checkout, is the model; its lead tools are in the same directory). Pre-register the registry and scenario-info entries with placeholders so each builder owns one directory, run oxfmt on scenario-info.ts after adding them, and tell builders that `fixture` reaches the scenario as a prop. Each builder builds into its own dist directory and shoots its own route. (2) Shoot each scenario with apps/playground/scripts/shots.ts, plus the keyboard frame, the list frame and the pointer sweep of cycle 8's lead tool (`lead-shots.ts` with `shoot-round.sh`; its keyboard frame skips scroll regions since cycle 8). (3) Reviewers: one fresh subagent per case and round, never the builder, with the case row, the shot paths, a snapshot of the scenario source for that round, docs/v3/expression/rubric.md and the shoot log. Tell it to open every shot. (4) Repair: hand the builder its reviewer's findings, at most two more rounds, shooting and scoring after each. (5) Diagnose every point lost in round 0 into one class from EXPRESSION.md § Finding classes, using the builder's wish list and its workaround comments as evidence. Where an open plan row already owns a gap, class the finding `planned` and append it as a `notes` entry to that row's brief instead of filing a row. (6) Judge the three hypotheses against EXPRESSION.md § Thresholds, using this cycle's numbers and the verdict lines of docs/v3/spikes/viz-census.md. (7) File per CYCLES.md step 6. A fix that adds a public export, changes charts/contract.ts or changes what primitive-bypass denies is one row with `checkpoint: spec` and seat opus high. Report factory friction with `factory signal file`, not as a row. Lead notes from cycle 8: (a) check v3-expr-8-kit-fixes before round 0 on a build of the pinned master: n30's keyboard frame (the focused heatmap cell draws a ring), n29's `?shot-state=error` (the BarList names its title), n31 and n29 at 390 (loading and rest share one height), cycle 7's n24 `?shot-state=loading` against its rest at 1800, n32's tree table (a focused row dims the rest); if any did not land, tell builders so the same gap does not cost twice; (b) check v3-expr-8-contract: tell reviewers what the Spec ruled and which fields shipped (a Sparkline point readout, bar value labels and a clamped stack, nested table rows); (c) check v3-expr-8-rubric: if its three sentences landed, the reviewer reads them from rubric.md; if not, tell reviewers the three readings the cycle-8 file records (F3 n/a where the data holds no reference; K3 scores the logged hosts and a scroll region is no keyboard evidence; X5 asks mono only for times and ids and a pill only where a baseline exists); (d) run `make check-fast` before scoring round 0, and stop it by pid before builders start round 1 only if it is still queued for a slot; (e) tell reviewers what cycle 8's reviewer prompt says about the two sanctioned colour forms, the 61 px band, the LIST approach and the shipped series-row, mono and stacked BarList fields; (f) keep the builder prompt's line to look at the page the way the skill's last step says, without naming the keys state, and count who shot a keyboard frame (cycle 8: 5 of 6, the sixth found no keys host on a Sparkline); (g) `demo/series.ts` is shared: tell builders to change only their own group with one Edit after a fresh Read and never to rewrite the file, and to run `bun test` on its own, not at the end of a compound command; (h) once this cycle runs, the bank's only never-run cases are n39 and the ones it adds: add at least five from pages no case covers yet, so cycle 10 can draw six, and say so; (i) report every score on all items and, for the trend against cycles 1 and 2, on the F and K items alone, as cycles 3 to 8 do; (j) the lead tool's list frame takes a chart's own HTML marks (`[data-chart-mark]` divs) for a list, as on cycle 8's n29: read each LIST line against its frame before handing it to a reviewer; (k) a cycle-8 reviewer read collapsed word spaces in n27's round-1 `PageSummary` headline (tight tracking, or a defect): confirm or rule it out on the first build whose headline holds a comma list.
